FIELDS.NAME: Melody Makers Instrument Repair & Sales
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Harmony Lane, Unit 2B, Music City, TN 37209-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Melody Makers Instrument Repair & Sales, we specialize in the retail and repair of a wide range of musical instruments, including guitars, pianos, brass, and woodwind instruments. Our operations encompass a dedicated retail space where customers can browse and purchase high-quality instruments and accessories. In addition, we offer professional repair services conducted by our experienced technicians, who possess documented qualifications and skills in instrument maintenance and restoration. We prioritize customer satisfaction and have implemented quality control processes to ensure that all repairs meet the highest standards. With secure display cases for our valuable inventory and a commitment to complying with local safety regulations, we aim to create a safe and welcoming environment for musicians of all levels. Our business operates with measures in place to protect our products and services.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Guitar Harmony Store, Music Repair Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2022, a customer reported damage to a guitar during a routine repair, caused by a malfunctioning tool. The cost of repairs was $2,000. The claim was resolved satisfactorily and preventative measures were implemented to avoid future occurrences.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 456 Melody Avenue, Suite 101, Music City, TN 37209
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-security safe, Class B, UL-listed for commercial use.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: High-security surveillance system with motion detectors and regular patrols during operating hours.
